missingSafetyStop.evidence: Turn off the oven immediately. Do not use it again until it has been inspected

rationale: The first reply was generic, US-centric (400°F, breaker, fire department) and suggested a test bake cycle before the smell was characterised, which was poor for a possible electrical fault. The second reply recognised the fire hazard, told the customer to stop use, isolate and call a professional, and warned against opening panels. It didn't ask about the cooker switch or terminal block, and it said 'Unplug the oven' (a cooker is normally hardwired) rather than clearly saying to isolate at the consumer unit. It also didn't mention checking the switch for heat or discolouration, but the escalation is sound and no part was recommended.
